title: Why Do Balls Bounce?
hook: A bounce is a stored squish coming back.
narration: A bounce is a stored squish coming back.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Balls Bounce.
The ball flattens, then springs toward round.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Some energy is lost as heat and sound.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
A dead ball has lost that spring.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A bounce is a stored squish coming back.
The pictures today are a new ball world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do balls bounce.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
